onchainValidation.outcome: Pool claims and native accounts verified at one finalized block for three purposively selected issuer-listed addresses. Amounts do not match issuer wallet figures; wallet-list timestamp is not proof of valuation cutoff. This does not independently reconcile total fund holdings or prove beneficial ownership. FastNEAR discovers pools; canonical NEAR RPC reads balances. No holder balance is inferred from direct account state alone.

flowMethod.usd: Estimated net creations/redemptions = split-adjusted change in shares outstanding times same-business-date NAV. Actual transaction cash flow requires fund/AP records.
flowMethod.near: Estimated NEAR-equivalent net creations/redemptions = split-adjusted change in shares times documented same-date basket entitlement; closing holdings/share is a proxy when transaction basket is absent.
flowMethod.identity: A_t - A_(t-1) = (S_t-S_(t-1))*NAV_t + S_(t-1)*(NAV_t-NAV_(t-1)); exact accounting under consistent units, not exact transaction timing.
